research.lore_anchor: Unused outlying portions of the Arx became buried by Baal dust storms before Dante ordered them unearthed ahead of the Tyranid invasion.
research.source_scope: Encyclopedia cites The Devastation of Baal, Chapter 2; complete book not independently consulted.
research.interpretation: The ruined gateway, wall fragments, buried route and their exact placement/design are invented visual interpretation of that history, not a named or mapped canonical landmark. No precise historical date set.
research.other_locations_considered: Chalice Mountains are calderas on Baal; Angel's Fall is on Baal Secundus and was not transplanted beside the Arx.
research.celestial_identity: Distant celestial body not specifically identified as Baal or one named moon. Camera is on Baal. All local clouds lie in front of it.

inspection.method: Assistant inspected the generated full-composition still, not motion/playback.
inspection.world: Most of the disc is visible at the prior approximate position/size, with a small soft cloud remnant near its lower-left edge; no numerical occlusion fraction measured.
inspection.plain: One dark ruined arched gate and low wall remains, sand-buried, subordinate in the middle distance. Faint ground route ties it toward fortress foothills.
inspection.preservation: Covered terrace, warm lamp, bench, parapet, main cathedral, one tallest-spire eagle, rust-red sky and horizon visually retained. Exact outside-edit pixel retention not claimed.
inspection.quality_scope: Fine material credibility, cloud interaction and the new ruin scale remain for user visual review.
